name: Undertaking Extension
definition: Specifies information related to the extension of an undertaking.

AutoExtensionPeriod.name: Auto Extension Period
AutoExtensionPeriod.definition: Requirement for a clause covering an automatic extension of the validity expiry date.

AutoExtensionFinalExpiryDate.name: Auto Extension Final Expiry Date
AutoExtensionFinalExpiryDate.definition: Date after which the undertaking will no longer be subject to automatic extension.

NonExtensionNoticePeriod.name: Non Extension Notice Period
NonExtensionNoticePeriod.definition: Minimum number of days of advance notification that must be given to indicate the undertaking  will no longer be extended.

NonExtensionIndicator.name: Non Extension Indicator
NonExtensionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the undertaking can be extended.

AutoExtensionNotificationPeriod.name: Auto Extension Notification Period
AutoExtensionNotificationPeriod.definition: Minimum number of days of advance notification given to indicate the undertaking will no longer be automatically extended.

NotificationRecipientType.name: Notification Recipient Type
NotificationRecipientType.definition: Type of party to whom the notice of non-extension is intended to be delivered, such as the applicant or beneficiary.

Undertaking.name: Undertaking
Undertaking.definition: Undertaking for which extension parameters are provided.
